tossups.question: The legs of females of these animals often have either hairs called scopa or basket-like structures called corbiculae. These animals were observed to tremble in response to ethanol and were found to be more susceptible to the Sacbrood virus after exposure to neonicotinoids (“neo-nih-KOT-in-oids”). Karl von Frisch first observed these animals using the sun’s position to communicate the direction of food. Populations of these animals develop deformed wing virus when their dwellings are infested by Varroa mites, which may also lead to colony collapse disorder. The nurse type of a species of these animals feeds royal jelly to their larvae. For 10 points, name these insects, some of which produce honey.

In this novel, a group of three sisters tells the protagonist that she “must remember to come back,” which is echoed in the novel’s closing lines. In this novel, Meme (“may-may”) breaks both of his arms by winning the First Annual Tarzan Jumping Contest. While in the monkey garden, this novel’s narrator watches a group of boys steal Sally’s keys. After noting that “In Spanish [my name] means too many letters,” the narrator of this novel wishes to change her name to Zeze the X. This novel consists of 44 vignettes about the coming of age of a Chicana girl in the title Chicago setting. For 10 points, name this novel about Esperanza Cordero by Sandra Cisneros.

bonuses.leadin: A D minor sarabande by Handel plays over duels in this director’s film Barry Lyndon. For 10 points each:
parts: Name this director who used music from a “Jazz Album” conducted by Riccardo Chailly (“shy-YEE”) in the film Eyes Wide Shut.
This Kubrick film prominently features microtonal Ligeti (“LIG-uh-tee”) pieces. In this sci-fi film adapted from an Arthur C. Clarke story, HAL 9000 turns on the crew of a spacecraft.
A Shostakovich piece in this genre was repopularized by Eyes Wide Shut and plays over its opening credits. A piece in this genre plays over the docking scene in 2001: A Space Odyssey.
